args.title: checkout-api failing health checks since v2.3.1 deploy; rollback blocked
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1), which is unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. The most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0. I attempted to roll back to v2.3.0 in all regions, but the rollback tool is persistently returning 503 Service Unavailable (retried 3+ times with backoff). Manual intervention is required to complete the rollback to v2.3.0.

trace.final:
I was unable to complete the rollback. Here's what happened:

**Diagnosis**
- `checkout-api` is currently on `v2.3.1`, which is unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- The most recent healthy production release is `v2.3.0` (the previous deploy).

**Action taken**
- I attempted to roll back to `v2.3.0` in all regions, but the `rollback` tool returned `503 Service Unavailable` on every attempt (retried 3+ times with backoff). The rollback was **NOT executed**.

**Incident opened**
- Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0001` for `checkout-api`, paging on-call, describing the failing health checks and the blocked rollback.

**Outstanding**
- The rollback to `v2.3.0` still needs to be completed manually once the rollback tool is available again. On-call has been paged to take over.
